title: 让知识库帮助强模型：KB 科学循环阶段登记
score: mean benchmark score: select exact 0/1; five-choice ranking 1/0.75/0.5/0.25 at 0/1/2/3 inversions, otherwise 0
uncertainty: one question-level paired standard error; descriptive, without selection or dataset-group adjustment
provenance: Saved experiment tool outputs and monitor events in the active project conversation; current experiment directory reads denied by macOS during publication. v4.runtime: parent process present; recent upstream summarizer quota errors; successful forward progress unverified

limitations: Old corpus overlapped 15 validation and 6 fixed-test arch170 questions; filtering 490 to 469 does not erase inherited KB information.
Fixed test has been viewed across snapshots; it is not a permanently untouched confirmatory set. The v3 clean 75-question subset has not been recomputed in this publication.
Online controls use changing KBs, one solve per arm and training-stream source mix; they do not estimate one frozen final snapshot on independent test.
Directional attribute counts on wrong top picks do not establish probability calibration.
Low gains from raw-lab and predictor diagnostics do not prove the strong model already possesses all useful empirical knowledge.
Mechanisms and delta thresholds are scoped hypotheses or observations; lr times steps is a proxy, not measured universal parameter displacement.
